summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a material-event notice to the Argentine National Securities Commission disclosing that its principal subsidiary, Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires S.A., as successor to HSBC Bank Argentina S.A., was notified of a class action (Expte. 24444/2024) filed by consumer association ACYMA in National Commercial Court No. 13. The suit seeks a two-year minimum validity for the HSBC-originated Rewards points program and compliance with anti-forfeiture obligations. Galicia states an unfavorable outcome is not expected to materially affect shareholders' equity. This is ordinary litigation disclosure, not a special situation.
